note:
website, stock_delivery: two more per-record loops. ir.ui.view._compute_first_page_id ran website.page.search(limit=1) once per view, which is a query per row of the Website > Pages list -- 21 queries for 20 views, now 2, pinned by TestFirstPageIdBatchCost. stock.picking._compute_allowed_carrier_ids searched delivery.carrier per picking when the domain only varies by company; the batch pass now resolves it per company, 20 queries for 6 pickings -> 15, 48 for 20 -> 29. That one does not go flat and this is not the reason: the ORM calls the compute for the whole recordset and then again once per record, on the original code as well.

Banked from a measurement of the rebased tree, not from arithmetic. Before the rebase this branch read 358 -> 356; origin had independently re-measured 359 after banking event's two batched loops. An exact floor fails downward as well as up, so the merged count is the one the CI command reports -- `tooling/lint/py_lint.py odoo addons --count`, n-plus-one-query row -- rather than either side's delta carried across.
